caseName: United States ex rel. McCarthy v. Cook
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. McCarthy v. Cook, Commanding Officer
attorneys: Thomas D. McBride and Hayden C. Covington for petitioner. Solicitor General Sobelojf, Assistant Attorney General Olney, Beatrice Rosenberg and Robert G. Maysack for respondents.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari denied. The motion to substitute Brucker, present Secretary of the Army, as a party respondent in the place of Stevens, resigned, is granted.
